scope: local Brief projection of fields consumed by the pinned R21 fingerprint_to_pins

findings.finding: The adapter checks request.offset and request.value_start only when the corresponding argument was supplied. It accepts unexpected optional selectors when offset/value_start are None, and it ignores other extra selector keys. The committed smallsort-brief CLI adds offset/value_start only when explicitly requested, so these echoes can be validated exactly.
findings.impact: A malformed targeted response can be accepted even though its echoed request differs from the adapter's actual CLI request; the receipt then records the local selector tuple rather than rejecting that mismatch. This fails the exact Brief request and fail-closed invariant.
findings.fix: Require the echoed request selector object to equal exactly {pointer, file_id, expected_sha256} plus offset or value_start only when that argument was sent; reject unexpected selectors and offset/value_start combinations. Add synthetic negative cases for unexpected and mixed selectors.

verified: review check matched exact candidate, spec, and packet; packet reports proof_credit NONE
